section: ## Section 2 -- How Regional Deductions Work / ### The Dual Structure of Spanish IRPF
wording: - **Dual structure of IRPF** — Spanish IRPF is split 50/50 between the State (cuota estatal) and the Autonomous Community (cuota autonómica). The state portion is fixed nationwide; the regional portion is where each CCAA can: 1. Modify the regional tax brackets (escala autonómica) 2. Create regional deductions (deducciones autonómicas) that reduce the cuota autonómica. Regional deductions apply AFTER computing the cuota íntegra autonómica. They reduce the tax owed to the regional government. They do NOT reduce the state portion.
destination: CORRECTED dual structure: current LF23 and1345–1348 calculate separate own scales/minima and allocations; the two actual tax liabilities are not automatically equal50/50. Regional credits reduce their own gross quota.

section: ## Section 4 -- Foral Territories / ### 4.3 Ceuta and Melilla
wording: - **Ceuta and Melilla benefits** — Ceuta and Melilla are NOT autonomous communities but autonomous cities. They use the common territory IRPF scale but benefit from: 60% deduction on cuota íntegra (Art. 68.4 LIRPF) for income generated there; 50% bonificación on cuota autónomos for specific sectors (Agriculture, Industry, Commerce, Tourism). This effectively means total IRPF rates are ~40% of what common territory taxpayers pay.  _(Art. 68.4 LIRPF)_
destination: CORRECTED current LF1509 and es-income-tax art68.4 method:60%applies only qualifying attributable tax under actual residence/source/asset conditions, not every Spanish liability×40%; SocialSecurity is separate. Historical50%sector concession not imported as a current IRPF credit.

section: ## Section 6 -- How to Apply Regional Deductions (Computation) / ### Step-by-Step Process
wording: - **Step-by-step computation process** — 1. Identify the taxpayer's Comunidad Autónoma of fiscal residence (where they lived on 31 December of the tax year) 2. Compute the cuota íntegra autonómica using that CCAA's regional brackets 3. Apply mínimo personal y familiar at the regional rate to get cuota líquida autonómica 4. Sum all applicable regional deductions for which the taxpayer qualifies 5. Cap: Total deductions cannot exceed the cuota líquida autonómica (floor = 0) 6. Result: Cuota diferencial autonómica = cuota líquida autonómica - deducciones autonómicas
destination: CORRECTED current LF25/1342–1348/1354–1358:community is not31Decemberaddress; minima reduce tax through separate scales before credits; result is regional liquid tax, not separate regional differential. Claims need actual entitlement and available quota.

wording: Birth/adoption/foster relief requires descendant-minimum entitlement. For the second/third-and-later amount, the preceding children counted for ordering must have been held for **more than 183 days**. The event credits a/b/c are compatible with one another and d under the express statutory conditions ([art. 4.Uno.a–d](https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-1998-8202#a4)).
